checks: Bad credentials show a useful error; successful login opens inventory.
Administrator records stock adjustment and updated dashboard/inventory.
Multiple order lines reserve, ship, partially return, and fully return with matching stock.
Zero-price SAMPLE order is valid; reserved cancellation releases stock.
Stale-version return retains input and can be refreshed, reviewed, and retried.
Order search, status filters, and empty results work.
Arbitrary client text is rendered as text, not HTML.
An interrupted successful write safely replays with the same key and preserved form.
Audit shows actor, reference, stock before/after, and adjustment reason.
390px mobile workflow supports create, reserve, ship, keyboard return, and no page overflow.
Viewer can inspect orders and audit with no mutation controls.
South is isolated; operator can fulfill but cannot adjust stock; reload retains session.
